name: frankie-poker
description: Open-source Texas Hold'em playground: play against language models, edit opponent strategies, and preview what the AI sees.

paragraphs: Play poker with language models. Give them a strategy. See how they play.

An open-source No-Limit Texas Hold'em playground for people who want to play against AI and experiment with how it makes decisions. Pick opponents, choose their models, edit their instructions, and inspect a sample hand before taking your strategy to the table.

This project will remain free and open source forever. If you’ve downloaded it or are using it, please Star the repository or Follow @SonghaiFan to keep up with my projects. Your Star is my biggest source of support and motivation to keep building.
features: Play against JEV, Gemini, Claude, GPT, Grok, DeepSeek, and Kimi through OpenRouter. Available models depend on the venue; provider availability can change.
Give each opponent its own model, play style, and prompt.
Switch between Edit and Preview to inspect your prompt on preflop, flop, turn, and river sample situations.
Add your own derived poker variables through registered plugins, then use them in the same editor.
Choose Offsuit (default minimal UI) or Frank (the original pre-minimal layout, cards and controls) in your avatar’s settings. The style saves on this device and changes presentation only.

whatItDoes.text: Play poker with language models. Give them a strategy. See how they play.

requirements.text: OpenAI-compatible mode accepts an HTTPS API base URL (including /v1 when required), a provider key, and a chat model ID.
Help me configure OpenRouter without reading or printing my API key.
